The Dark Secret of the "Father of Gynecology" #history
candidates.source_description:
J. Marion Sims is still called "the father of gynecology." But between 1845 and 1849, he built his fame by experimenting on enslaved women without anesthesia — one of them, a teenager named Anarcha, endured around 30 operations. Statues of him stood in New York and South Carolina… until 2018.
